description: This file defines a LinkedList class implementation in Kotlin, including node management, addition, removal, size calculation, and element retrieval methods.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with methods to add, remove, get size, and access elements by index.

classes.name: LinkedList.Node
classes.description: A private inner class representing a node in the linked list, storing a string data element and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list. Returns true if removal was successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if index is invalid.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helper method to unlink (remove) a node from the list given the previous node.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Private companion object method to find the last node of the list starting from the head.
